एड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Deaf.
 E. ईड् to praise, आङ् prefixed, अच् or घञ् aff.

एडक m. (-कः)
 1. A ram.
 2. A wild goat.
 f. (-का) A ewe.
 E. ईल् to go,
ण्वुल् affix; and ल changed to ड.

एडगज m. (-जः) A medicinal plant, used for the cure of ring-worms,
(Cassia tora.)
 E. एड a sheep, गज to sound, अच् aff.

एडमूक mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
 1. Deaf and dumb.
 2. Wicked, perverse.
 E. एड
deaf, and मूक dumb.
